items.title: How Three Artists Scored No. 2 Hot 100 Hits Without Doing Anything on the Songs
items.summary: These three artists reached the runner-up spot on the Billboard Hot 100 with songs bearing their names — but not any of their musical contributions.

items.title: Hayley Williams’ Duo Power Snatch Release EP2
items.summary: Back at the beginning of the year, Hayley Williams announced that she was teaming up with producer and longtime collaborator Daniel James to form a duo with the great name Power Snatch. A few days later, they dropped the Bandcamp exclusive EP1, their first collection of songs. Since then, Power Snatch have covered This Is Lorelei, shared new music via Instagram post, and teamed up with London artist Tiberius b for a couple of songs.

items.title: Hannah Cole – “Mechanical Bull”
items.summary: Last month, Nashville's Hannah Cole announced her debut album Switchbacks and unleashed the gritty lead single "MMA." Now, she's sharing the grungy, frustrated anthem "Mechanical Bull." The post Hannah Cole – “Mechanical Bull” appeared first on Stereogum.

items.title: Mal Not Bad – “DHF”
items.summary: In June, LA's Mal Not Bad announced their sophomore LP Sophomore, slated for September. It looks like it's been pushed to early 2027, but we're getting another preview today with the new single "DHF" and a music video that involves a dance choreography in a church. The post Mal Not Bad – “DHF” appeared first on Stereogum.
